# Sales Data Analysis

## Objective

Analyze sales data to identify:
- Sales trends over time
- Seasonal sales patterns
- Performance of different product categories and products

## Dataset

The dataset used for this project is the Superstore Sales Dataset from Kaggle.

## Tools & Technologies

- Python
- Pandas
- Matplotlib
- Seaborn
- Jupyter Notebook

## Analysis Performed

### 1. Monthly Sales Trend
Analyzed monthly sales to identify changes in sales over time.

### 2. Seasonal Sales Analysis
Compared sales across different months to identify seasonal patterns.

### 3. Category Performance
Compared total sales across product categories.

### 4. Product Performance
Identified the top-performing products based on total sales.

## Key Findings

- November 2018 recorded the highest monthly sales.
- February 2015 recorded the lowest monthly sales.
- Sales were generally stronger from September to December.
- Technology had the highest total sales among the three categories.
- Canon imageCLASS 2200 Advanced Copier was the top-performing product by total sales.

## Visualizations

The project includes:
- Monthly Sales Trend
- Seasonal Sales by Month
- Sales by Category
- Top 10 Products by Sales

## Conclusion

The analysis shows clear sales trends and seasonal patterns in the dataset. Sales increased strongly during the September to December period, while Technology was the highest-performing category. The analysis also helped identify the products contributing the most to overall sales.
